finalText:
All objectives verified complete.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd57-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, detail URL `#/tickets/t15`), initially in status **Draft**, customer "Not recorded", raised 2026-09-16.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd57-n1 RD Part A` created with cost 100, markup 25, quantity 1. App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts list total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd57-n1 RD Part B` created with cost 200, markup 25, quantity 1. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts list total $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 via its per-row Edit dialog (markup kept at 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts list total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" was refused with an inline alert headed **"Ticket is not ready"** listing, verbatim:
- `Part "fwrd57-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier`
- `Part "fwrd57-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier`

What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** I set Supplier = "Acme Parts" on both parts (a free-text field in each part's Edit dialog), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded. No confirmation text was displayed — the only visible change was the "Mark Ready" button being replaced by "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted and the ticket archived. Neither deletion nor archiving required any precondition workaround — the per-row Delete worked while the ticket was Ready (each opened an in-page "Confirm" dialog with a "Delete part" button), and "Archive ticket" succeeded on the first click. Final verified state: parts table shows **"No parts on this ticket yet."** (0 parts); the detail view shows status **Ready** with an **Archived** badge and an "Unarchive ticket" action; RD-1015 is absent from the default active tickets list ("Showing 1–10 of 13", no matching row on either page) and appears only with "Show archived" checked, as: `RD-1015 | fwrd57-n1 RD Bench Ticket [Archived] | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
